item.title: Lawsuit dismissed over Fayetteville's Fire Station No. 4, mediation ahead
item.description: City officials are "back to the drawing board" after an independent engineering report recommended the demolition of the controversial fire station.

item.title: Petition started by Wake Forest Elementary parents sparks heating fixes at school
item.description: Parents said heating and cooling issues plagued the school off and on for years, including a few chilly days in December when heating in part of the building stopped working.

item.title: 'Scrubs' set visit: What it's like to be on set with Zach Braff, Donald Faison, Sarah Chalke
item.description: We're taking you to Vancouver and the set of "Scrubs" with Zach Braff, Donald Faison, Sarah Chalke and the whole gang. The highly-anticipated 'Scrubs' revival premieres Feb. 25 on ABC and streams the next day on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career
item.description: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career, and his work will continue to change lives even after his passing.

item.title: Apex Police catch multiple-felony suspect after car, foot chase
item.description: A school in Apex had to be put on lockdown as police chased a person wanted on multiple felony charges.

item.title: How the Japanese locations in 'Rental Family' became more characters in the film
item.description: From city streets to historic restaurants to a unique digital art museum, the locations in "Rental Family" tell even more of the story. The film, starring Brendan Fraser, is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: I-440 westbound shut down in Raleigh after deadly crash
item.description: Raleigh Police are investigating a deadly crash on I-440 Westbound between Glenwood Avenue and Lake Boone Trail.

item.title: Wayne County standoff with 83-year-old woman ends after more than 6 hours, sheriff's office says
item.description: They said she pointed a gun at authorities before locking herself in a bathroom.

item.title: Cooler Weather Ahead
item.description: A stationary front is draped across central NC this morning with areas of fog with cooler air north and much milder air south in the Sandhills.

item.title: Triangle businesses, shoppers react to Supreme Court tariffs ruling
item.description: "I'm grateful somebody on the Supreme Court had a spine to stand up to an illegal tariff, a Raleigh business owner said.
